packageRules.description: SPFx packages move in lockstep with their toolchain (TypeScript, ESLint, Heft, Node) — Renovate only lists the release on the Dependency Dashboard; the upgrade itself is a deliberate task (see README 'Upgrading SPFx')
Toolchain versions are dictated by the SPFx release — change only with an SPFx upgrade
tslib ships inside the web part bundle (TypeScript helpers), so it gets updates — a version change also needs THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, which `just check` enforces
SPFx 1.23 supports Node 22 only — Node majors change only with an SPFx upgrade
